evidence.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS cnt
FROM properties
WHERE roof_age_years > 15
  AND (
    3958.7613 * acos(
      least(1.0,
        cos(radians(28.492001615631427)) * cos(radians(latitude)) * cos(radians(longitude) - radians(-81.72883850361254))
        + sin(radians(28.492001615631427)) * sin(radians(latitude))
      )
    )
  ) <= 5
sourceSystems: Lake County CD Plus permit layer + Clermont eTRAKiT permits

evidence.sql:
SELECT property_id, request_identifier AS parcel_id, address_street, address_city, address_zip, latitude, longitude, roof_age_years, roof_age_basis, roof_last_permit_date
FROM properties
WHERE roof_age_years > 15
  AND (
    3958.7613 * acos(
      least(1.0,
        cos(radians(28.492001615631427)) * cos(radians(latitude)) * cos(radians(longitude) - radians(-81.72883850361254))
        + sin(radians(28.492001615631427)) * sin(radians(latitude))
      )
    )
  ) <= 5
ORDER BY roof_age_years DESC
LIMIT 200
